{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it really a string with commas?
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique revenue values with commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Check if any contain commas
contains_comma = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of revenue entries with commas: {contains_comma.sum()}")

# Show a sample of raw strings
print("\nSample of raw revenue strings:")
print(sales['revenue'].sample(5))"}
